notes: Top-line: enterprise logistics provider, strict residency & KMS reqs. POC focused on low-latency chat (driver support) + high-throughput reranking for search. Wants throughput guarantees and firm latency SLOs (p95 < 120ms for chat, p99 < 400ms for reranking under planned load). Interested in Dedicated with VPC/private control plane; may mix with Private on-prem nodes in East US hub.
use_case_summary: Driver-facing chat agent (real-time routing), search/rerank of manifests and documents, embeddings for similarity search across freight docs. Peak burst patterns during morning/evening dispatch windows; baseline QPS ~80, peak burst to 220 QPS for short windows.
poc_results: Baseline Dedicated config (4x A100 equiv) achieved sustained 90 QPS with p95=110ms on Llama-3-32B quantized; burst test showed queueing spike at sustained >140 QPS leading to p95 jumps to 260ms. Observations: cold-start overhead for model variants ~70-120ms, KV cache warmup required ~1500 tokens to hit steady-state. Batching helps throughput but increases tail latency under burst. SE recommended warm pool of pre-warmed model instances + short queue depth with overflow to hosted tier for non-critical reranks.
capacity_plan_summary: Initial reserved plan proposed: 8 A100-equivalent GPUs (reserved) with 2-node warm pool for critical chat paths and autoscale headroom to +50% for sustained growth. Scale-up policy: add a GPU when 1-min avg queue depth >12 for 60s OR CPU/GPU utilization >75% for 90s. Scale-down: remove when 5-min avg utilization <30% AND queue depth <4 for 10m (longer cooldown to protect p95). Pre-warm policy: maintain 2 warm replicas warm for LLM chat variant; warm-pools lifecycle tied to weekly dispatch patterns. Fallback routing: overflow traffic to hosted API with token-based routing and degraded SLO, enabled for non-sensitive reranks.
sla_negotiation_status: Draft SLA circulated 2026-03-10. Harbor QL wants 99.95% availability on Dedicated control plane, p95 latency credits starting at 99.9% compliance, penalties capped; Redwood proposed 99.9% initially with escalations and a 90-day ramp. KMS/HSM integration clauses under legal review. Negotiation points: uptime target, remedy credits calculation, support response times (4hr critical), scheduled maintenance windows.
commercial_notes: Cost sensitivity moderate — prefers predictable reserved pricing with burst pricing cap. Estimated ARR bracket $250k-$1M depending on committed GPUs and support tier. Prefers annual commitment with option to add burst credits. Procurement asked for a 3-year TCO comparison vs self-hosting (internal infra team).
sales_playbook_recommendation: Offer 12-month reserved capacity with 3-month ramp credits, include warm-pool feature as add-on and a dedicated SE onboarding package. Prepare an explicit capacity modeling workbook showing token/sec economics and a runbook for autoscale thresholds. Provide SSO/KMS integration plan and security workshop schedule.
